claims.claim_text: SoFi Bank, N.A. is a nationally chartered bank (national association) regulated by the OCC, FDIC and Federal Reserve, and SoFi Technologies operates as a bank holding company.
claims.source_quote: SoFi Technologies, a bank holding company, and SoFi Bank, a nationally chartered association, are required to comply with regulatory capital rules issued by the Federal Reserve and other U.S. banking regulators, including the OCC and FDIC.
claims.subject: SoFi Bank, N.A.
claims.extraction_notes: FDIC BankFind is the authoritative registry of insured-depository charter status. Active charter + national-association class corroborates the claim; inactive or missing would contradict.

claims.claim_text: SoFi Bank held approximately $18.6 billion of deposits as of December 31, 2023, with approximately 98% insured.
claims.source_quote: We achieved continued strong growth in deposits, ending the year with $18.6 billion of deposits as of December 31, 2023 ... As of December 31, 2023, approximately 98% of our total deposits were insured.
claims.subject: SoFi Bank, N.A.
claims.extraction_notes: FDIC Call Report ASSET / deposits line for SoFi Bank's CERT (resolved via BankFind) provides registry-side confirmation of the deposit base near year-end 2023.

claims.claim_text: SoFi Bank's loan-portfolio credit quality (charge-off rate, nonaccrual rate) as of year-end 2023 is consistent with the issuer's representation of being well-capitalized with a 15.3% total capital ratio and no material credit deterioration.
claims.source_quote: Our total capital ratio, as calculated under applicable regulatory capital rules, was 15.3% as of December 31, 2023. ... our regulatory capital ratios exceeded the thresholds required to be regarded as a well-capitalized institution.
claims.subject: SoFi Bank loan portfolio
claims.extraction_notes: Call Reports surface NTLNLS (net charge-offs), NCLNLS (nonaccrual), ASSET, NETINC, ROAQ/ROEQ. Material divergence between Call Report credit-quality trajectory and the 10-K's 'no material deterioration' tone would be a hard signal for this cohort.

claims.claim_text: SoFi Securities LLC operates SoFi Invest as a broker-dealer registered with the SEC and member of FINRA.
claims.source_quote: we offer personal loans, student loans, home loans and related servicing ... We also offer a variety of financial services products, such as SoFi Money checking and savings, SoFi Credit Card, SoFi Invest, and SoFi Relay
claims.subject: SoFi Securities LLC
claims.extraction_notes: FINRA BrokerCheck is the authoritative registry for U.S. broker-dealer registration; absence or inactive status would contradict the SoFi Invest brokerage product claim.

claims.claim_text: SoFi acquired Wyndham Capital Mortgage in the second quarter of 2023, which expanded its home loans capacity.
claims.source_quote: Our acquisition of Wyndham in the second quarter of 2023 provided increased capacity and capabilities for our home loans product
claims.subject: Wyndham Capital Mortgage
claims.extraction_notes: Acquisition should leave a paper trail in SoFi's 8-K filings (item 2.01) and subsequent 10-Q/10-K disclosures around Q2 2023.

claims.claim_text: SoFi recognized goodwill impairment charges of $124.5 million for the Galileo reporting unit and $122.7 million for the Technisys reporting unit during the third quarter of 2023.
claims.source_quote: the fair value of the Galileo and Technisys reporting units were determined to be below their carrying values by 9.9% and 14.8%, respectively, resulting in management recognizing goodwill impairment charges of $124.5 million and $122.7 million for the Galileo and Technisys reporting units, respectively.
claims.subject: Galileo and Technisys reporting units
claims.extraction_notes: The impairment is internal to SoFi accounting; external corroboration is limited to SoFi's own Q3 2023 10-Q (filed pre-cutoff). edgar_fts on SoFi's own CIK verifies the disclosure cadence exists; no third-party registry observes the carrying value of a reporting unit.

claims.claim_text: SoFi sponsors asset-backed securitizations of personal loans (and other loans), and the issuer regularly files securitization-related SEC reports (ABS-15G, ABS-EE, 10-D, 424B5).
claims.source_quote: Our borrowings primarily included our loan and risk retention warehouse facilities, asset-backed securitization debt ... we market [personal loan residual interests in our sponsored personal loan securitizations] to third parties ... Note 7. Securitization and Variable Interest Entities
claims.subject: SoFi-sponsored securitization shelf
claims.extraction_notes: SoFi as sponsor should have ABS-15G representations-and-warranties filings; depositor-CIKs may carry ABS-EE/10-D. Absence of any ABS filings under SoFi Technologies CIK is OK because the sponsor's depositor SPVs typically file under their own CIK. This is a forward-only directional check.

claims.claim_text: SoFi maintains an office presence in Argentina (Buenos Aires) and Uruguay (Montevideo) supporting the Technology Platform (Technisys) segment, and benefits from a 100% Uruguay software-services tax holiday plus an Argentine Knowledge-Economy Regime tax holiday.
claims.source_quote: we qualify for a tax holiday in Argentina by fulfilling certain requirements of the Regime for the Promotion of the Knowledge Economy (Law 27,506). The regime is in effect from January 1, 2020, through December 31, 2029. ... we are operating under a 100% tax holiday in Uruguay due to our software-related services.
claims.subject: SoFi (Technisys) foreign operations

proposed_connector.name: argentina_economia_conocimiento.query_beneficiaries
proposed_connector.description: Argentina Ministry of Economy / Secretaría de Industria y Desarrollo Productivo registry of beneficiaries of the Regime for the Promotion of the Knowledge Economy (Ley 27.506), which lists each enrolled software/services firm with start date and tax-rate reduction.
proposed_connector.sample_invocation: GET https://www.argentina.gob.ar/economiadelconocimiento/beneficiarios -> parse PDF/CSV -> filter rows where razon_social ILIKE '%Technisys%' or '%SoFi%'
proposed_connector.rationale: The 10-K asserts Technisys/SoFi qualifies under Ley 27.506; the only authoritative confirmation is the Argentine government's published beneficiaries roster. No US-side registry adjudicates a foreign-statute tax holiday.
proposed_connector.completeness: Argentine Knowledge-Economy Regime enrollees only; updated on ministry schedule

claims.extraction_notes: No US-side connector adjudicates foreign tax-holiday status. Proposing the Argentine Ministry beneficiaries list as the registry analog; expectation is low scoring weight given access friction.
